meanings.note: Conversational Russian particle ('not') that adds modal nuance, emphasis, or negation in spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Наше новое начальство не знает расписания.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'быть'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to forget', forming an aspectual pair with 'забывать'.

examples.text: Чёрт, я забыл записать свой банкет!
examples.trans: Damn, I forgot to write down my banquet!

examples.text: Вечно кто-нибудь всё перепутает или забудет.

examples.text: А вы что здесь забыли, кто вас впустил?
examples.trans: And what are you all doing here, who let you in?

записать.gloss: to write down; to save (a contact)

meanings.en: to write down; to save (a contact)
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'писать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to write down', forming an aspectual pair with 'записывать'.

examples.text: Чёрт, я забыл записать свой банкет!
